findings_resolved: Preparation previously lacked a durable attempted-run identity. The exclusive invocation marker now precedes expensive grant/source/interpreter/history validation.

Completion alone did not establish a successful final readback/clock/return. Successors now require an exact independent execution-accounting review and verify every prior actual directory is represented once.
limitations: Source review does not claim that catchable Python or filesystem calls guarantee return under an unresponsive OS. Final tool closure and independently verified accounting remain necessary.
No dynamic negative accounting-chain test was executed; the first grant has an empty predecessor chain.
reviewed_invariants: Absolute per-invocation deadlines start before imports and include preparation. Cleanup/reap algorithm is retained from accepted predecessor.
Each grant carries total passage budget300 seconds, exact prior review chain, prior sum and finite limits within the remaining charge. No reset or refund.

Every predecessor review pins its consumed grant, invocation marker and closed evidence, and explicitly confirms final tool outcome, closure and full readback. A missing or uncertain accounting review refuses a successor.
Successful completion charges the measured parent interval plus a nonrefundable5-second closing reserve; final exact completion readback and clock must fit that charge.
A preparation/final exception preserves a parent_failure record when the early marker exists; its measured final closed interval must be independently accounted before any successor.

Only one reviewed child is started with fixed interpreter and args; no automatic retry. Child starts in its own process group, signal sequence is bounded, and unconfirmed reap cannot receive accepted closure.
scope: Incremental stdlib supervisor review; no candidate import or execution by reviewer.
